detail.readme_excerpt: # [![Mattermost logo](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7205829/137170381-fe86eef0-bccc-4fdd-8e92-b258884ebdd7.png)](https://mattermost.com) [Mattermost](https://mattermost.com) is an open core, self-hosted collaboration platform that offers chat, workflow automation, voice calling, screen sharing, and AI integration. This repo is the primary source for core development on the Mattermost platform; it's written in Go and React, runs as a single Linux binary, and relies on PostgreSQL. A new compiled version is released under an MIT license every month on the 16th. [Deploy Mattermost on-premises](https://mattermost.com/deploy/?utm_source=github-mattermost-server-readme), or [try it for free in the cloud](https://mattermost.com/sign-up/?utm_source=github-mattermost-server-readme).
